classificationLegend.M: machine-verifiable source, contract, test, Player, build, or retained evidence
classificationLegend.H: human comprehension, comfort, accessibility usability, creative, and integrated-playtest disposition

requirements.statement: Real blocking jobs and actual byte totals drive truthful resumable install or patch presentation.
Approved media loops independently while media terminal state remains separate from readiness and routing.
Finished Loading requires media terminal, every mandatory readiness provider, and destination activation readiness.
A visible focusable explicit Continue accepts one operation exactly once and never auto-routes.
Realm remains draft data and deterministically derives exactly one Race without independent Race selection.
ClassFamily is explicitly selected from the four current families and is never defaulted or inferred.
Customization edits remain versioned draft state and cannot mutate authoritative save before receipt and projection.
Username is a public handle independent of stable ProfileId and preserves the full draft across validation outcomes.
One operation yields a matching authoritative receipt and verified local projection before gameplay admission.
Every incomplete cursor resolves to its exact step and completed onboarding enters WorldIntro, never Kingdom.
The nonquest tutorial completes movement then a common basic-attack command exactly once without requiring combat outcome.
Tutorial completion foregrounds the existing OMEN_1 as OFFERED with SELECT_VALERIUS and never auto-accepts or duplicates it.
The active quest title and objective invoke the same nonmutating accessible follow action.
After OBJ_C1_ACCEPT_MARK, appointment precedes grant and both precede Kingdom unlock.
Only the shared menu enters unlocked Kingdom and returns while preserving profile, quest, objective, and navigation context.
Every mandatory action has keyboard, controller, touch, and accessible semantic activation with deterministic focus and non-color/non-audio-only meaning.
Build, package, load, frame, CPU, GPU, GC, memory, thermal, crash, ANR, and LMK claims are measured and attributable to an exact build and device.

hardFails.statement: Finished Loading is shown while a required blocking dependency is pending, unknown, or failed.
Elapsed time, nominal video duration, skip, fallback, or media completion implicitly advances readiness or routing.
A recoverable failure strands input or omits an actionable bounded retry or exit.
Repeated input, callback, or retry creates a second transition, operation, character, tutorial completion, quest change, or milestone.
Realm-only or otherwise incomplete evidence reaches WorldIntro or Kingdom.
Race is independently selectable or ClassFamily is absent, defaulted, inferred, or outside the four accepted values.
Draft Realm, Race, ClassFamily, customization, or username mutates authoritative save before a matching receipt and projection.
ProfileId equals, derives from, changes with, or is rendered as username.
Receipt-only, projection-only, mismatched, stale, forged, or uncertain authority admits gameplay or a new operation replaces unknown outcome reconciliation.
The tutorial is skipped, becomes a quest, changes order, or requires hit, damage, target, kill, reward, or PvP semantics.
Tutorial completion accepts, progresses, completes, or duplicates OMEN_1 instead of foregrounding its existing OFFERED state.
OMEN_1 stable identity is wrong or the active title/objective is nonclickable, pointer-only, mutating, teleporting, or relocating.
OMEN completion grants Kingdom or appointment, grant, and unlock occur out of order or duplicate.
A permanent gameplay-HUD control bypasses the shared-menu-only Kingdom transition or loses round-trip context.
Restart advances, rolls back, fabricates completion, loses valid draft/payload, or repeats a committed mutation.
Player or evidence output exposes username as internal identity, raw machine ID, localization key, exception, provider response, stack trace, secret, or PII.
A critical instruction or state is available only through color, audio, haptics, or pointer interaction.
Focus order traps the user or a mandatory primary action is unreachable after input, lifecycle, or layout change.
Editor, emulator, or simulator evidence is represented as physical-device passage.
Machine or statistical passage is represented as human comprehension, comfort, creative, accessibility-usability, or user approval.
Protected third-party art, UI layout, text, formula, audio, video, iconography, lore, or branded expression is copied into AnotherLife authority.
A green fragment test, static capture, Editor preview, planning record, or isolated Game Test is reported as integrated production passage.
Retry discards valid verified download bytes or silently redownloads them without evidence.
Required dialogue or cinematic meaning has no caption or audio-off parity.
Reduced-motion or decode-fallback behavior changes loading truth, timing authority, or mandatory journey semantics.

humanGates.statement: First-time players understand the current state, required action, and consequence at each mandatory journey boundary.
The integrated presentation is recognizably AnotherLife, narratively faithful, and visually accepted by the user.
Camera, motion, flash, pacing, audio, and interruption behavior are comfortable in an integrated playtest.
People using the supported accessibility paths can complete and understand the journey without assistance from an excluded modality.
The user accepts the player-facing identity, recovery, logging, and evidence-handling behavior after privacy review.

metrics.warmupDefinition: cold and warm cohorts reported separately

metrics.name: media-first-frame

metrics.measurementPoint: media prepare request to first presented frame

metrics.name: windows-gameplay-frame-time

metrics.warmupDefinition: report peak and five-minute steady separately

nonClaims.statement: This artifact does not establish a working production end-to-end first-user route or runtime readiness.
This artifact does not certify truthful install, patch, media-loop, or Finished Loading behavior in a packaged Player.
This artifact does not approve a production identity, username, receipt, projection, persistence, save, recovery, or privacy implementation.
This artifact does not certify WorldIntro, tutorial, OMEN_1, CH01, or cross-mode Kingdom integration.
This artifact does not establish package size, memory, frame-time, latency, thermal, crash, ANR, or broad-device compliance.
This artifact does not declare supported devices, platforms, orientations, viewports, safe areas, or input hardware.
This artifact does not certify accessibility, caption parity, reduced-motion comfort, controller usability, touch usability, or human comprehension.
This artifact does not grant cinematic, visual, creative, narrative-copy, localization, player-playtest, production, milestone, or release approval.
This artifact excludes and does not approve PvP, combat balance, skills, effects, monetization, matchmaking, or post-slice gameplay.
No third-party visual, audio, video, UI, text, lore, iconography, formula, or branded expression is admitted by this coordination evidence.
